final_message: Parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and extracting only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, uppercased levels, extracted messages and exceptions (last traceback line or null), and calculated repeat counts including repeated message lines. Aggregated counts by service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
